neighbours.label: An everyday activity during which something else goes on ('as I walk', 'on her way to work', 'in the car', 'while driving', 'while the child is asleep'); the same nouns as plain places or objects stay quiet.
fire: I get my best ideas while I jog.
He listens to podcasts on his way to the office.
Audiobooks in the car make the trip pass quickly.
Our bodies repair themselves while we sleep.
I caught the news on the radio while commuting.
She knits on the train every morning.
People often check their phones when they wait in line.
He hums while he washes the dishes.
quiet: I get my best ideas from old books.
He bought a podcast mic for the office.
Tires on the car make the trip safer.
Our bodies are made mostly of water.
I bought a radio at the station shop.
She sold the train set last year.
People often pay their bills at the bank.
He bought the dishes at a flea market.
